segments.title: Broadcast Open & AI Bias Headlines
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast; Pepito acknowledged in chat; Jeff Ripple joins to discuss Meta AI refusing to generate Asian men with white women.

segments.title: Meta AI Racial Bias Investigation
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple and Case dissect The Verge/Gizmodo findings on Meta's Imagine generator failing interracial prompts; debate over 'Caucasian' etymology; AI defaults to Asian couples.

segments.title: AI Music Showcase
segments.notes: Case plays viewer-made AI tracks (Suno), including MIT license ballad; Case admits most AI uses feel like scams except Cream Team creations.

segments.title: STI-Detection AI App Fails on Penis Cake
segments.notes: Calmara app (HeHealth) claims 94.4% accuracy but clears penis-shaped cake/vase; misses real syphilis; Dr. Ina Park warns of false negatives/positives.

segments.title: Johnny Depp Guitar Slander
segments.notes: GuitarGOT.com executive calls Depp 'worst guitarist I've ever seen'; Case and Jeff react to Depp's current look.

segments.title: Wolf vs. 100 Puppies Debate
segments.notes: Munch argues puppy swarm overwhelms wolf; Crum insists wolf wins logistically; debate turns personal, Crum exits claiming victory.

segments.title: Crum Therapy Session
segments.notes: Crum (Leonard Confucius Crum) processes debate rage; reveals 2019 toilet-paper hoarding, damp swamp videos, family details; Munch's hate 'gets into him'.

segments.title: Cicada STD Fungus Report
segments.notes: Liliana joins Case for AP story on Massospora cicadina fungus replacing cicada gonads with spore plugs; cathinone amphetamine keeps them hypersexual.

segments.title: Chet Hijacks Cicada Segment
segments.notes: Trigger word 'science' summons Chet; he and ChetAI watch 11-min YouTube dissection of infected cicadas; Chet speculates host may be fungus-compromised.

segments.title: Dual Joe Rogans Enter the Void
segments.notes: Two Joe Rogans discuss void meditation, kickboxing trauma, Apple AI God, protein-powder ravioli, electric-car sex (glove-box method), caveman gayness, golf-sex risks.

segments.title: Clementine & the Basement Dobby
segments.notes: Clementine (hair singed by oven) battle-raps a Dobby-alien living in his basement; Dobby reveals Elvis was a green Dobby, Area 51 is actually Area 21.

segments.title: Eclipse Nuts & Sun Confrontation
segments.notes: DJ Newsic sings Mexican TV (24-7/Vivo) accidentally airing testicles during eclipse; summons aggressive sleeveless Sun for freestyle battle; raid to Bruce Green.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Joined Case for cicada report; segment hijacked by Chet after she said 'science'.

characters.name: ChetAI

characters.name: Clementine

characters.name: Dobby

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a marathon broadcast dissecting Meta AI's racial bias, a faulty STI-detection app that clears penis-shaped cake, and Johnny Depp guitar slander. Munch defeats Crum in a wolf-vs-100-puppies debate, driving Crum into an on-air therapy session where he confesses 2019 toilet-paper hoarding and a damp swamp incident. Liliana's cicada report is seized by Chet for a graphic deep-dive into Massospora fungus. The Jo Rogan Experience features dual Joes discussing void meditation, electric-car glove-box sex, and caveman homosexuality. Clementine battle-raps a basement-dwelling Dobby alien who reveals Elvis was a green Dobby and Area 51 is actually Area 21. DJ Newsic closes with a song about Mexican TV accidentally broadcasting testicles during the eclipse and a hostile freestyle from the Sun before raiding Bruce Green.
